title: Jesus... I Keep Rehearsing Arguments That Never Happen. 🎭
topic: he keeps rehearsing full arguments against people who never said a word and calls it being prepared

bible.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I keep rehearsing arguments that never happen.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: In the shower, before every meeting, on the drive home. Full speeches to people who never said a word.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are litigating a fight I never asked you to attend.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I don't prepare, they'll catch me off guard. I froze once and it cost me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I was in the room that day too. The answer isn't a better script; it's knowing you don't walk in alone.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Bring Me the thoughts instead of rehearsing them. My comforts are made for the multitude.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone whose brain never clocks out. 🧠
